evidence.claim: GenImage++ is explicitly introduced as a new test-only benchmark for future detector evaluation, extending generators and prompt/style conditions.
Common SDv1.4 training paradigm; nine generator/prompt strata compare13 external detector variants with OMAT CLIP+LoRA R4 using reported per-subset Accuracy%.

Specified generators and prompt engineering; subset sizes6k,18.3k,30k,6k,18.3k,18.3k,6k,30k,6k (138,900 generated images total). Construction and prompts support reuse independently of method performance.
No matched real images in this test-only resource. Its results do not measure a balanced real/fake test or specificity.

quantitative_evidence.metric_limitation: Source calls these Accuracy%; because GenImage++ is generated-only, interpret as generated-class detection performance, not balanced authenticity accuracy/AUC. Nine-stratum mean differs from image-weighted scoring.
